$$10 Dq = 16,474 + 4,453.5 = 20,927.5 \text{ cm}^{-1}$$

Checking with $\nu_2$:
$$\nu_2 = 10 Dq + 2 C = 20,927.5 + 4,453.5 = 25,381 \text{ cm}^{-1}$$
